rationale: The story revolves around the literal cost of a single physical unit—a printed page—and the ink that produces it. Editorial macro emphasizes the stark physical reality of the page and the ink cost, drawing attention to the specific physical artifact that carries the economic weight.

core_thesis: The cost of printing a page is determined by subscription quotas and overage fees, where a refillable ink tank printer breaks even against high-volume plans within three years.
core_conflict: subscription overage fees versus upfront capital hardware costs
composition: extreme asymmetry with hero subject off-centre on the right
